title: Sleep story - The Cottage by the Tide

parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Hello, and welcome. <short pause> Tonight's story is called The Cottage by the Tide. <short pause> Find a position that feels easy, and let the bed take all of your weight.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Breathe in slowly through your nose... <short pause> and let it go. <short pause> If your mind wanders while I speak, that's alright. <short pause> Just come back to the sound of my voice, the way a wave comes back to the shore.

At the end of a long, sandy lane, where the grass gives way to dunes, there is a small white cottage with a blue door. <short pause> It belongs to a man named Tom, who has lived by the sea for most of his life. <short pause> He knows the sound of every kind of weather, and the smell of the air before rain.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: It is early evening, at the very end of summer. <short pause> The heat of the day has gone, and the air is soft and cool. <short pause> The sun is sinking into the sea, slowly, the color of apricots. <short pause> And the tide is going out, leaving the sand wet and shining.

Tom pulls on an old woolen sweater and steps outside. <short pause> He walks barefoot down the little path through the dunes. <short pause> The sand is still warm on top, and cool underneath. <short pause> The tall grass whispers against his legs as he passes.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Down on the beach, the sea is calm. <short pause> Small waves fold over, one after another, and slide up the sand in thin, lacy lines. <short pause> They pause. <short pause> And then they slip back again, with a soft hush, like someone saying, shh.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: In... <short pause> and out. <short pause> In... <short pause> and out. <short pause> The sea has been breathing like this for longer than anyone can remember.

Tom walks slowly along the waterline. <short pause> He isn't looking for anything in particular. <short pause> Now and then he bends down to pick up a shell, smooth and pale pink inside. <short pause> He turns it over in his fingers, and puts it in his pocket. <short pause> A few gulls drift overhead, calling softly, heading home for the night.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Little rock pools have been left behind by the tide. <short pause> Tom kneels beside one. <short pause> The water is perfectly clear and perfectly still. <short pause> A tiny crab sidles under a stone. <short pause> A ribbon of green seaweed sways gently, back and forth, though there is no wind at all.

By the time he turns back toward the cottage, the sun has gone. <short pause> The sky is fading from pink to lavender to deep, quiet blue. <short pause> The first star appears just above the dunes. <short pause> And in the cottage window, the lamp he left on is glowing, small and golden, waiting for him.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Inside, the cottage smells of wood and salt and old books. <short pause> Tom lights a small fire in the stove, just enough to take the chill off. <short pause> He fills the kettle, and while it heats, he sets the shell on the windowsill, beside all the others he has gathered over the years.

He makes a cup of warm milk with a little honey stirred in. <short pause> Then he sits in his favorite armchair by the window, with a soft blanket over his knees. <short pause> The fire crackles quietly. <short pause> The kettle ticks as it cools. <short pause> And outside, the sea keeps up its slow, steady rhythm.

Tom doesn't turn on the radio. <short pause> He doesn't pick up a book. <short pause> He simply sits, and listens, and lets the evening be enough. <short pause> Some days are busy and full of noise. <short pause> But this part of the day is his favorite... <short pause> the quiet part, when everything has been done that needs doing.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: The moon rises over the water, and lays a long, silver path across the sea, all the way to the shore. <short pause> The waves catch the light as they fold over, and then they go dark again. <short pause> Light... <short pause> and dark. <short pause> In... <short pause> and out.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Let yourself be there with him now. <short pause> The warm blanket. <short pause> The low glow of the fire. <short pause> The window, and the moon, and the sea just beyond it. <short pause> Nothing to do. <short pause> Nowhere to go.

After a while, Tom's eyes grow heavy. <short pause> He finishes the last of the warm milk, banks the fire, and climbs the narrow stairs to his small bedroom under the roof. <short pause> He leaves the window open just a crack, so he can hear the waves.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: The bed is soft, and the quilt is heavy and warm. <short pause> A cool breath of sea air drifts in through the window. <short pause> And the sound of the tide fills the little room, gentle and endless.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Let your breathing follow the waves, the way Tom's does. <short pause> Breathe in, as the wave rises... <short pause> and breathe out, as it slides back down the sand. <short pause> In... <short pause> and out. <short pause> Slower each time.

The tide will turn while you sleep. <short pause> It will come back in, softly, all on its own, the way it always does. <short pause> You don't need to watch it. <short pause> Just rest. <short pause> Goodnight.
